statement.text:
Does there exist a group G satisfying the following four conditions:
    1) G is simple, moreover, there is an integer n such that G = C n for any conjugacy
class C,
    2) all maximal abelian subgroups of G are conjugate in G,
    3) every maximal abelian subgroup of G is self-normalizing and it is the centralizer
of any of its nontrivial elements,
    4) there is an integer m such that if H is a maximal abelian subgroup of G and
a ∈ G \ H then every element in G is a product of m elements in aH?
    Comment of 2005: There is a partial solution in (E. Jaligot, A. Ould Houcine,
J. Algebra, 280 (2004), 772–796).                                              B. Poizat
